name: concise
description: English. The answer goes in the first sentence; cut preamble and process narration; keep every caveat that changes what the reader does. Governs chat replies, plans, decisions, commit messages, PR descriptions, cards, review comments and release notes — and the text written into code, from comments to screens. Forces its output style on while enabled, restates the style beside every prompt, and ships a SessionStart hook with self-update, a credit guard on the commands that publish text, thirteen commands — rewrite, pr, card, commit, comment, release, plan, decide, draw, status, handoff, audit, trim — and an audit agent.
